SAAB:
NOT A CAR,
A CHARACTER

BORN FROM JETS
{b}{b}{b}{b}{b}{b}{b}{b}

THE SEATS.
OF COURSE.

ONCE A SAAB,
ALWAYS A SAAB

WE FLY LOW {b}

BEST SOUND
IN THE WORLD:
TURBO WHISTLE

ARE NOT SOLD.
THEY ARE
PASSED ON

JUST YOU AND
THE ROAD

AIRCRAFT IN 1937

PRODUCTION SAAB

CARLSSON WON

SAAB 900:
1978 - 1993

TURBO MADE
TURBO COOL

Saab is not a car.
It's a personality

Trollhättan:
our second home {b}{y}

A Saab doesn't age.
It gains patina

Didn't start?
Check the key
between the seats

Swedish logic:
strange at first,
brilliant later

Swedish design:
beautiful, solid
and a little odd

Parked nose out.
It has earned it

Garage: Saab
Heart: Saab
Spare parts: searching

A day without Saab
is a day
on the bus

Windshield curved
like a cockpit {b}

Saab club meets
on Fridays.
And every other day

Not like the others.
And proud of it

Dashboard built
like a cockpit

Cleared for takeoff {g}
- Saab tower

Heated seats
are a very
Swedish idea

The griffin
on the wheel
like a coat of arms

prototype was
shown in 1947

Fact: Sixten Sason
shaped the
first Saab

Fact: early Saabs
had two-stroke
engines

Fact: the Saab 96
was built from
1960 to 1980

won Monte Carlo
twice in a Saab

Fact: Carlsson's
nickname was
"on the roof"

arrived in 1968

convertible
came in 1986

was built from
1984 to 1998

shared a platform
with Fiat Croma

is named after
a fighter jet

the first to fit
heated seats

Fact: Saab built
small sports cars
called Sonett

Fact: Saab means
Svenska Aeroplan
Aktiebolaget

logo came
from Scania

merged in 1969

arrived in 1955

families from 1959

Championship

100,000 km

over 200 km/h

restraints debuted

for Direct
Ignition cassettes

1970 to 1974

nicknamed

9-5 arrived
in 1997

side built the
Draken and Viggen

was built
until 1956

married rally
driver Pat Moss

Turbo is not
an option.
It's a lifestyle

Every Saab
has a name.
Even if unspoken

Saw a Saab?
Flash your lights

You don't buy
a Saab.
You choose one

Love at first
turn of the key

One more lap
around the block?
For the turbo

A real Saab smells
of fuel, leather
and adventure

Quiet please!
The Saab
is resting

Wheel, pedals,
turbo.
What else?

No extra buttons.
Just the right ones.
Many of them

Long road ahead?
Saab agrees

A Saab only asks
for good oil
and some love

Warning: owning
a Saab
is addictive

Your first Saab
is never
your last

Home is where
your Saab
is parked

We're not late.
We're warming
up the turbo

Saab in winter:
heated seats
and a smile

Saab in summer:
roof down,
wind in your hair

Question of the day:
which Saab
was your first?

Question of the day:
900 or 9000?

Question of the day:
hatchback or
convertible?

Saab 9000 Aero:
calm outside,
wild inside

Saab 99:
grandfather of
every turbo Saab

Saab 96:
small, loud
rally champion

Saab Sonett:
a little
Swedish dream

Saab 9-5:
big, quiet
and very quick

The mechanic says
"well, it's a Saab"
and smiles

Washed the Saab.
It rained.
The Saab is happy

Mood: a drive
with no
destination

Saab fears
no snow, no rain
and no Mondays

Saab engineers
thought
like pilots

There are cars.
And there
are Saabs

An airplane
on wheels,
parked at home

Saab 900:
a design that
never got old

400,000 km?
For a Saab
that's a warm-up

A Saab doesn't
break down.
It asks for attention

Show me your Saab
and I'll tell you
who you are

Saab club:
old cars,
new friends

A warm garage is
the best gift
for a Saab

The sound of
a Saab door
closing is music

The glovebox keeps
secrets of
past owners

Skis, bikes
and still room
in the hatch

Saab drivers spot
a Saab by its
lights, miles away

Saab in the
driveway:
already a good day

Saab therapy:
30 minutes
behind the wheel

Don't touch
my Saab.
Praise it instead

Family tradition:
there is always
a Saab here

Kids ask:
"is it a plane?"
Almost, kiddo

Coffee run
in the Saab? {o}

An old Saab
beats
two new cars

This house speaks
fluent Saab

In doubt?
Choose Saab

Life is short.
Drive a Saab

Saab today,
Saab tomorrow,
Saab forever

Turbo lag?
A pause before
the thrill

Swedish engineering
with a sense
of humor

Front wheel drive,
heart wheel drive

A Saab never
follows trends.
It sets them

Keep calm
and turbo on {y}

One car,
many stories

Born from jets,
raised on
snowy roads

The best seat
in the house
is in the Saab

Sunday plan:
wash the Saab,
admire the Saab

Saab people
wave at
each other

Every scratch
tells a story

Built for
Swedish winters,
loved everywhere

Classic shape,
timeless soul

Turbo whistle:
our favorite song

Our Saab has
more history
than our house

Hatchback life:
everything fits

Drive it like
you love it
